content: when can we use Trutakna and why do we use it

According to Context 1 and Context 3, Trutakna (ATACICEPT) is a prescription medicine used to reduce proteinuria in adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) who are at risk of their disease getting worse.

The specific indication for Trutakna is to reduce proteinuria in adults with IgAN at risk for disease progression. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on a reduction of proteinuria. It has not been established whether Trutakna slows kidney function decline over the long-term in patients with IgAN. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory clinical trial.

[Trutakna (ATACICEPT), page 2]

According to Context 2, AVLAYAH (TIVIDENOFUSP ALFA-EKNM) is a hydrolytic lysosomal glycosaminoglycan (GAG)-specific enzyme indicated for the treatment of neurologic manifestations of Hunter syndrome (Mucopolysaccharidosis type II, MPS II) in pediatric patients weighing at least 5 kg prior to advanced neurologic impairment.

This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on a reduction of cerebrospinal fluid heparan sulfate observed in patients treated with AVLAYAH. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial.

[AVLAYAH (TIVIDENOFUSP ALFA-EKNM), page 1]

content: Tell me the steps on how to use rinvoq

According to Context 4, the steps for using RINVOQ (RINVOQ LQ) are as follows:

1. Use RINVOQ exactly as your healthcare provider tells you to.
2. Use RINVOQ 1 time each week.
3. RINVOQ is given as an injection under the skin (subcutaneous injection).
4. Inject RINVOQ under the skin in the stomach area (abdomen) at least 2 inches away from the belly button (navel), or the front of the thigh.
5. Choose a different site for injection each time you use RINVOQ.

The detailed Instructions for Use that comes with RINVOQ provides further information on how to prepare and inject a dose of RINVOQ, as well as how to properly store and throw away (dispose of) used RINVOQ autoinjectors.

[Context 4, page 79]
